total_model.summary: Model projects 40.2 total points (CAR 22, TB 18). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 3.1), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 0.8), Divisional game (lowers total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
